run_climate_fever_preprocessing: run the ClimateFever dataset preprocessing to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_climate_fever_dataset: create a ClimateFever classification dataset instance with Supports, Refutes, Not enough info, and Disputed labels
load_climate_fever_hf_dataset: load the climate_fever HuggingFace dataset using datasets.load_dataset for claim verification tasks
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of claim and label tuples for classification
split_train_test_lines: split the ClimateFever test set into 80/20 train and test lines using random shuffle
